import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        
        // Handle empty or very short strings
        if (s.length() <= 2) {
            // No middle part to replace
            System.out.println(s);
            return;
        }
        
        // First replacement: replace "dot" with "." in the middle part
        String middle = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
        middle = middle.replace("dot", ".");
        s = s.charAt(0) + middle + s.charAt(s.length() - 1);
        
        // Second replacement: replace first occurrence of "at" with "@" in the middle part
        middle = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
        int index = middle.indexOf("at");
        if (index != -1) {
            middle = middle.substring(0, index) + "@" + middle.substring(index + 2);
        }
        s = s.charAt(0) + middle + s.charAt(s.length() - 1);
        
        System.out.println(s);
    }
}
